Isha Rikhi Responds to Reports on Separation from Rapper Badshah

Punjabi actor Isha Rikhi has broken her silence following reports of her separation from rapper Badshah. She described the news as "shocking" and urged the public not to believe unverified claims about her personal life. Rikhi stated she is keeping the specifics of their relationship private. The couple reportedly dated for nearly four years before marrying quietly, with their union becoming public in March 2026 when Rikhi's mother shared wedding photos.
